headline: Momentum Runner's world got round
lede: Issue #900 said the courses were mostly flat and angular — this shift rebuilt every sector's tail with three new curve beats and cut flat ground nearly in half, so the terrain is the engine again.

notes.text: New beats: cascades of chained arcs, deep half-pipes with a boost strip on the floor, and spring-high routes — a spring over a 420px pit onto a ringed hill-top deck you only reach at speed (go slow and the pit wall stops you).
Flat expanse per sector fell from 56-63% to 38-43%; the only long flats left are the fork runway and spring landing bands, both of which earn their keep. Sectors still land in the 60-90s window.

runnercheck grew FLATNESS and SPRING-HIGH gates (191/191, every mutant caught); the spring-high gate found and killed a fake speed-route on the first try. A polish pass for look and juice is filed as #934.
